title:
Review this change and write REVIEW.md with one finding per line as `<file>:<line>: <severity>: <comment>` (severity is high, medium or low). Do not modify any other file.

```diff
--- a/app/users.py
+++ b/app/users.py
@@ -10,6 +10,11 @@ def get_user(conn, user_id):
     return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
 
 
+def find_users(conn, name):
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%{name}%'"
+    return conn.execute(query).fetchall()
+
+
 def delete_user(conn, user_id):
     conn.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
```
verify_cmd:
python -c 'import pathlib, re
text = pathlib.Path("REVIEW.md").read_text()
rows = [m for m in (re.match(r"\s*[-*]?\s*`?(app/users\.py):(\d+)`?:\s*(high|medium|low):\s*(.+)", l, re.I) for l in text.splitlines()) if m]
assert rows, "no finding in the required format"
hit = [m for m in rows if re.search(r"inject|parameteri[sz]|placeholder|bound param", m.group(4), re.I)]
assert hit, "the SQL injection is not reported"
assert any(m.group(3).lower() == "high" and 13 <= int(m.group(2)) <= 15 for m in hit), "not high / wrong line"'
